## Context
When six dev lanes wait to land and three more sessions need a lane, I want the worktree cap at 18, so a fix lane can be cut while the landing queue drains. On 2026-11-19 at 14:00 UTC the cap of 14 refused the frozen-push re-cut. Three slots are held by owner items. Orchestrator decision 2026-11-19 14:01 UTC (dev-j6oqo).
payload.title: Raise the worktree cap from 14 to 18 while six lanes wait to land
